info.title: Refgenieserver REST API
info.description: a web interface and RESTful API for reference genome assets

get.description:
List genomes with their aliases and asset counts, most asset groups first,
then by species name and digest. With ``q``, best matches come first:
an exact name, then a whole word of a name, then a word start, then the rest.

Exact-match filters:
- digest: Filter by exact genome digest
- alias: Filter by exact genome alias
- has_assets: Only genomes with (true) or without (false) assets
- taxon_id: Filter by NCBI taxon id
- store: Only genomes present in any of these stores (comma-separated).
  This is membership, so a genome held by several stores matches each.
  An unknown store name is a 422.

Searchable fields: see ``SEARCH_FIELDS`` in ``refgenie.db.queries.genome``.
An unknown alias gives an empty page, not a 404.

get.description:
Download an archive by its asset digest.

Redirects to a remote the archive was pushed to, if any; otherwise serves
the local file.

The file must be listed in the staged ``directory_contents``. Redirects to
a remote the file was pushed to, if any; otherwise serves it from
genome_stage_folder.

Only genomes with assets are counted. Genomes with no species name are
grouped under "Unknown".

AssetNameResponse.title: AssetNameResponse
AssetNameResponse.description:
One name of an asset, with the provenance of the build behind it.

Provenance is per name: two builds with identical content share one
``Asset`` but each has its own name row. All-null means no build recorded.
``from_attributes`` as on ``SeekKeyResponse``.

AssetResponse.title: AssetResponse
AssetResponse.description:
Public API model for an asset.

Adds fields read from ``Asset`` ORM properties, including the resolved
``serving_modes`` (override, then asset class, then default). Kept off
``AssetPublic`` so ``serving_modes`` does not become a DB column.

is filled from ORM rows nested in ``AssetResponse``; the parent's config
does not reach nested models.
